(: Repeats of AddresseeIdentifier must each have a unique combination of valid AddresseeIDType, IDTypeName and IDValue :)     count(AddresseeIdentifier) eq     (count(distinct-values(AddresseeIdentifier[exists(IDTypeName)]/string-join((AddresseeIDType | IDTypeName | IDValue), '	'))) +     count(distinct-values(AddresseeIdentifier[not(exists(IDTypeName))]/string-join((AddresseeIDType | IDValue), '	'))))
(: There must be an IDTypeName if (and only if) IDType is proprietary :) matches(AddresseeIDType, '^(01|02)$') eq exists(IDTypeName)
(: IDValue must be a valid GLN (invalid characters) :) (AddresseeIDType ne '06') or matches(IDValue, '^[0-9]{13}$')

(: IDValue must be a valid GLN (check digit error) :) (AddresseeIDType ne '06') or not(matches(IDValue, '^[0-9]{13}$')) or (number(substring(IDValue, 1, 1)) + number(substring(IDValue, 3, 1)) + number(substring(IDValue, 5, 1)) + number(substring(IDValue, 7, 1)) + number(substring(IDValue, 9, 1)) + number(substring(IDValue, 11, 1)) + number(substring(IDValue, 13, 1)) + 3 * (number(substring(IDValue, 2, 1)) + number(substring(IDValue, 4, 1)) + number(substring(IDValue, 6, 1)) + number(substring(IDValue, 8, 1)) + number(substring(IDValue, 10, 1)) + number(substring(IDValue, 12, 1)))) mod 10 eq 0
(: IDValue must be a valid SAN (invalid characters) :) (AddresseeIDType ne '07') or matches(IDValue, '^[0-9]{6}[0-9Xx]$')
